paragraphs.source_en: “Madame Magloire,” said the Bishop, “you will put white sheets on the bed in the alcove.” We have already explained the character of the two women’s obedience. Madame Magloire retired to execute these orders. The Bishop turned to the man. “Sit down, sir, and warm yourself. We are going to sup in a few moments, and your bed will be prepared while you are supping.” At this point the man suddenly comprehended.
